name: cowart
description: A local infinite canvas for Codex, powered by tldraw and built for structured annotations, current-page image request queues, and canvas-native generation workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, annotate, and generate on a local infinite canvas in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Cowart brings a tldraw-powered infinite canvas into Codex for visual planning and creative iteration. Agents can read selected or current-page canvas structure, consume structured annotations with get_cowart_annotations, process current-page AI image holder requests with get_cowart_requests, and use confirmed object segments through refine_cowart_segment and make_cowart_mask. Image assets and Segment Store records stay in the user's project workspace; screenshot export remains available when structured canvas context is not enough.
defaultPrompt: Open the Cowart canvas for this project and inspect the selected or current-page structured annotations.
Process the current page's requested Cowart AI image holder queue and fill each requested holder from its prompt and references.
Revise images from Cowart's structured annotations or confirmed object segments first, using screenshots only as fallback context when needed.
